Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Writ Petition No.20659 Of 2024
Order:

Heard Ms. N. Maheswari, learned Counsel representing Sri K. Mallikarjun, learned Counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondents and perused the record.

2. The case of the petitioners, in brief, is that the respondent authorities are illegally trying to acquire the land of the petitioners admeasuring Ac.1.39 gts. belonging to the 1st petitioner and land admeasuring Ac.1.37 gts. belonging to the 2nd petitioner in Sy. No.9/40 situated at Thimmaipally village, Kandukur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District for the purpose of installation of 120 fault limiting line series reactors on both the circuits of 400 KV Maheshwaram (PGCIL), 400 K.V. Maheshwaram (TS) QMDC line for the benefit of TS TRANSCO and have issued Award enquiry notice under Section 21 of the of Right to Fair Compensation, and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act') without following proper procedure for acquisition, payment of compensation, determination of rehabilitation and resettlement benefits and by not considering the objection submitted by the petitioners on 22.07.2024 viz., the date of hearing as per Award enquiry notice dated 22.06.2024, as being illegal, arbitrary and violation of Articles 14, 300-A of the Constitution of India and also oppose to principles of natural justice.

3. Per contra, the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondents submits that the land acquisition proceedings were initiated by getting preliminary notification in Form C published in 'Andhra Prabha' Telugu Daily newspaper and 'Hindu' English Daily newspaper on 14.02.2024 and thereafter a declaration under Section 19 of the Act was also published on 14.02.2024 in 'Andhra Prabha' Telugu Daily newspaper and 21.06.2024 in 'Hindu'
English Daily newspaper.
4. Learned Government Pleader further submits that after publication of the declaration, the authorities have issued Award enquiry notice dated 22.06.2024 under Section 21(1) of the Act directing the interested parties to appear before the authority on 22.07.2024 .
5.

Learned Government Pleader further submits that on the said date fixed for causing Award enquiry, the petitioners have submitted their objection to the land acquisition proceedings initiated and that the said objections submitted by the petitioners are under consideration.

sentences.text:
1 6. Learned Government further submits that since the authorities have not yet passed the Award,
the objections submitted by the petitioners in response to the Award enquiry notice dated 22.06.2024 would be duly considered at the time of passing of the Award.

7. Learned Government Pleader further submits that since the petitioners by the aforesaid objections filed are claiming the subject property in respect of which a patta was issued in the name of one Puchala Chennaiah and after his demise the said land being succeeded by the husband of the 2nd petitioner being one of the son of late Chennaiah and the 1st petitioner being the son of the original assignment patta holder, the authorities took into the aforesaid claim.

8. Learned Government Pleader further submits that the aforesaid land was originally assigned in favour of Puchala Chennaiah is recorded as 'Sarkari' in revenue records and that out of the extent of Ac.6.09 gts assigned in favour of late Chennaiah under lavani patta, the authorities are now seeking to resume the land to an extent of Ac.3.36 gts only.
9.
I have taken note of the respective contentions urged.

10. Without delving into the merits of the rival claims, since on behalf of the respondents, it is stated that the objections submitted by the petitioners in response to the Award enquiry notice issued under Section 21(1) of the Act dated 22.06.2024 is pending consideration inasmuch as no Award having been passed as of date, this Court is of the view that the respondent authorities are to be directed to consider the aforesaid objection filed while passing of the Award and take further action in respect of the proposed acquisition in accordance with law.
11.
Subject to the above direction, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
